Bill Gates' daughter's startup investigated over affiliate commission claims

Phia, a startup co-founded by Bill Gates' daughter, is reportedly under investigation for allegedly claiming commissions from online sales it did not generate. The company has acknowledged a coding issue, stating it has been resolved. The allegations have prompted renewed discussion about affiliate marketing practices and the methods used by browser extensions to earn commissions.
